figurative_meaning_bn: তুমুল ঝগড়া, দাঙ্গাহাঙ্গামা, ভীষণ গোলমাল, মারামারি, ভীষণ ব্যাপার
figurative_meaning_en: fierce quarrel, riotous commotion, tremendous chaos, violent brawl, major uproar
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় হঠাৎ খণ্ডপ্রলয়ের মতো গোলমাল শুরু হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: All hell broke loose inside the house.
The meeting suddenly turned into complete chaos like a partial apocalypse.
history: Derived from the Hindu concept of 'Pralaya' (cosmic dissolution or deluge), adapted to describe localized, catastrophic events in everyday language.
note: The idiom draws from mythological imagery of partial destruction to vividly depict intense human conflicts.
